interactions/click-gantt.why: Clicks send filters: {AETERM: [...]} (the message D2/D3 extend); the footer names the column label (Reported Term = Rash); Reset clears with filter_type categorical, the type it latched.

interactions/click-gantt-drill-column.why: The click sends filters: {USUBJID: [S01]}, and the footer names that filter (USUBJID = S01) instead of the lane (Rash).

interactions/click-gantt-facet.why: A click in the Low Dose panel filters USUBJID = S02 and ARM = Low Dose, and the footer says both in column labels.

interactions/click-gantt-transient.why: The drill event sends filters: {AETERM: [Rash]}; the receipt reads Drilled down to Reported Term = Rash.

interactions/gear-drive-gantt.why: A gear edit that clears the filter sends filter_type categorical, not range.

interactions/restore-gantt.why: The restored filter reads Filtered: Reported Term = Rash, in the column's label.
